---
title: "Catalog"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The catalog lists every openwashdata data package by tier. Catalogued
packages have completed the openwashdata review and carry a Zenodo DOI;
candidate packages have requested review and are shown unreviewed.

```{r}
library(owdata)

reviewed <- owd_packages(tier = c("catalogued", "candidate"))
DT::datatable(
  reviewed[, c("pkg_name", "title", "tier", "version", "doi", "url_docs")],
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 25)
)
```

Packages still in development are listed for transparency; no dataset
or variable detail is harvested for them.

```{r}
dev <- owd_packages(tier = "dev")
DT::datatable(
  dev[, c("pkg_name", "title", "version", "url_github")],
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 10)
)
```
